name: Thumbnail Grid / Contact Sheet Generator
description: Combine a batch of images into a single printable contact sheet grid to review them all at a glance before submission.
body:
🖨️

Drop images here or click to browse

Up to 50 images per sheet

Preview

Drop images to generate a contact sheet.

Building sheet…
howto: Choose how many columns and how large each thumbnail should be.
Decide whether to show file names under each thumbnail.
Drop the images you want to review onto the dropzone.
The tool builds a contact sheet and previews it.
Click Download contact sheet to save it as a printable JPG.
features: Optional file-name labels for easy identification
Handles up to 50 images per sheet

faq.a: A single image that lays out many smaller previews in a grid. Photographers use them to review a whole shoot at a glance before selecting or submitting images.
Yes. Download it as a JPG and print or share it — ideal for marking up which images to submit to a stock platform.

faq.q: What happens with more than 50 images?
faq.a: The tool processes the first 50. Split the batch into two runs for larger sets, or raise the thumbnail size to fit more per sheet.
No. The sheet is composited on a canvas entirely in your browser.
